alternatives_rejected.why: frontend-external_error is a symptom; the slowdown originates in recommendationservice's own spans (self-time p50 0.99->2.28ms, 2.31x), not in frontend (E2), and the top metric deviations are recommendationservice disk I/O and latency (E1).
No productcatalogservice metric appears among the significant deviations (E1), and the latency increase is in recommendationservice's own self-time, not time spent waiting on downstream calls (E2).

proposed_fix.description: Investigate and relieve the disk I/O pressure on the recommendationservice pod. Find the process or volume that is saturating disk, for example runaway writes or a noisy neighbour. Throttle or stop it, or reschedule the pod onto a healthy node, then confirm that recommendationservice p90 latency and frontend errors go back to baseline.
